subject: E-Commerce
title: Smart Mirrors in Stores
description: One-minute skill: Smart Mirrors in Stores.

hook.text: Nike's smart mirrors detect what shoes you're holding and show reviews, sizing data, and similar styles on the glass.

buildup.text: Smart mirrors bring online features into physical stores: reviews, recommendations, & cross-selling in the fitting room.

discovery.text: Ralph Lauren's smart fitting rooms detect what you brought in and suggest matching accessories on the mirror display.

twist.text: Smart mirrors cost $10,000-15,000 each. Most retailers can't justify the investment for incremental sales lift.

climax.text: Smart mirrors merge online and offline shopping. The physical store gets digital superpowers but at a steep price.

punchline.text: $15K per mirror for reviews in the fitting room.

quiz.question: What do smart mirrors do in retail stores?
options: Display product information, reviews, and recommendations on the mirror surface
